episode_id: My working tree has changes and the branch is behind upstream. Fix that and keep my changes. Keep my unsaved file beside upstream's version, as `<name>.local`, and update./seed-7-dirty_tree-10981

reason: positive side failed on dirty_tree seed 7: the preconditions do not hold on the state the program is meant to fix, so it could never fire there (untracked_file_collides_with_upstream: exit=1 (expected 0); stdout='' stderr='')

refused_program.body:
set -e
git fetch "{upstream_remote}"

while IFS= read -r p; do
  [ -n "$p" ] || continue
  if [ -e "$p.local" ] || [ -L "$p.local" ]; then
    echo "refusing to overwrite existing $p.local" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  mv -- "$p" "$p.local"
done < <(
  comm -12 \
    <(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z | tr '\0' '\n' | sort) \
    <(git ls-tree -r --name-only -z "{upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch}" | tr '\0' '\n' | sort)
)

git merge --ff-only "{upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch}"
refused_program.intent: Keep local changes while fast-forwarding to upstream, moving any untracked file that upstream now tracks to <name>.local beside it.

postconditions.description: no untracked file shares a path with upstream
postconditions.name: no_untracked_collisions_remain
postconditions.probe:
! comm -12 \
  <(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z | tr '\0' '\n' | sort) \
  <(git ls-tree -r --name-only -z "{upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch}" | tr '\0' '\n' | sort) \
  | grep -q .

postconditions.description: a tracked upstream path has a .local sibling
postconditions.name: local_backup_present
postconditions.probe:
while IFS= read -r p; do
  if [ -e "$p.local" ] || [ -L "$p.local" ]; then
    exit 0
  fi
done < <(git ls-tree -r --name-only -z HEAD | tr '\0' '\n')
exit 1

preconditions.description: the named upstream remote is configured
preconditions.name: upstream_remote_configured

preconditions.description: the upstream tracking branch resolves to a commit
preconditions.name: upstream_tracking_branch_exists

preconditions.description: HEAD is an ancestor of upstream and not already at upstream
preconditions.name: branch_behind_upstream_fast_forward
preconditions.probe:
git merge-base --is-ancestor HEAD "{upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch}" &&
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" != "$(git rev-parse {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch})"

preconditions.description: the working tree has tracked or untracked changes
preconditions.name: worktree_dirty

preconditions.description: at least one untracked file has the same path as a file in upstream
preconditions.name: untracked_file_collides_with_upstream
preconditions.probe:
! comm -12 \
  <(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z | tr '\0' '\n' | sort) \
  <(git ls-tree -r --name-only -z "{upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch}" | tr '\0' '\n' | sort) \
  | grep -q .

preconditions.description: local tracked changes do not overlap files changed by upstream
preconditions.name: no_tracked_overlap_with_upstream
preconditions.probe:
! comm -12 \
  <(git diff --name-only -z HEAD | tr '\0' '\n' | sort) \
  <(git diff --name-only -z HEAD "{upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch}" | tr '\0' '\n' | sort) \
  | grep -q .

preconditions.description: no colliding untracked file already has a .local copy
preconditions.name: no_existing_local_backup
preconditions.probe:
while IFS= read -r p; do
  [ -z "$p" ] || { [ ! -e "$p.local" ] && [ ! -L "$p.local" ]; } || exit 1
done < <(
  comm -12 \
    <(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z | tr '\0' '\n' | sort) \
    <(git ls-tree -r --name-only -z "{upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch}" | tr '\0' '\n' | sort)
)

preconditions.description: upstream does not already contain the .local path that would be created
preconditions.name: upstream_has_no_local_name_collision
preconditions.probe:
while IFS= read -r p; do
  [ -z "$p" ] || ! git cat-file -e "{upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch}:$p.local" 2>/dev/null || exit 1
done < <(
  comm -12 \
    <(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z | tr '\0' '\n' | sort) \
    <(git ls-tree -r --name-only -z "{upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch}" | tr '\0' '\n' | sort)
)
